comment: Demo call history for scripts/dev-ops.mjs. Each call has exactly the keys GET /api/vapi returns per call (src/ops/vapi-calls.ts VapiCall). startedAt is relative New York wall time ('-2d 11:05' = two days ago at 11:05am); endedAt null = startedAt + durationSeconds. A book_tour slotId of '$slot:+1@14:00' is replaced with a real open slot id from GET /api/calendar (tomorrow, 2pm NY, or the nearest later slot that day); {{tour_when}}, {{tour_day}}, {{tour_date}}, {{tour_time}}, {{tour_iso}} in any text become that slot's time. With --seed, every tool result is replaced by what the real handler returned. See README.md.

AI: Thanks for calling The Larkin. I'm an AI assistant for the building and this call is recorded — how can I help?
User: Hi, yeah, I'm looking for a one bedroom. I saw the building on StreetEasy.
AI: Happy to help with that. When are you looking to move?
User: First of October, maybe a little after — my lease is up end of September.
AI: Got it. And a one bedroom — is that firm, or would a one bedroom with a den work too?
User: A one bedroom is fine. A den would be nice but not a must.
AI: And roughly what monthly rent are you working with?
User: Around five thousand. Five two at the most.
AI: Thanks. Let me check what's open for October. I have a few one bedrooms in your range. Residence 14C is a One Bedroom, 688 square feet, $4,910 a month, available October first, with one month free on a 14-month lease. There's also 18J, a One Bedroom and Den at $4,935 from October 5th, and 08E at $4,475 from October 24th.
User: 14C sounds right. What floor is that?
AI: 14C is on the fourteenth floor, facing east over the East River and the Midtown skyline. Would you like to come and see it?
User: Yeah. Quick question first — is there parking in the building?
AI: There is — an 84-space attended garage in the cellar with the entrance on 5th Street, staffed 24 hours. A space runs $425 a month, month to month with 30 days' notice.
User: Okay, good. Can I come by tomorrow?
AI: Let me look at the calendar. Tomorrow I have 10, 10:30, 11 or 11:30 in the morning, or later in the afternoon.
User: Eleven works.
AI: Can I get your name for the booking?
User: Marcus Bell.
AI: You're all set, Marcus. I've got you down for {{tour_when}} to see residence 14C. Would you like the confirmation by email as well?
User: I'll just take the text, thanks. See you tomorrow.
AI: See you {{tour_day}}, Marcus. Thanks for calling.
